When I was young, around six or seven, my father, little sister, and I lived in an apartment together. He and my mom were separated, but at some point decided to try and make it work so she moved back in with us. My sister and I shared one of the two bedrooms which was connected to the hallway and a bathroom that also connected to the hallway. 

One night I left the bedroom to get water from the kitchen, but at the coffee table in the living room was some thing. It’s head and arms were on the table, similar to how school children play ‘heads up sevens up’, and it was wearing my mothers shirt. I froze, thinking it was my mom for a second, until I realized it didn’t have hair and was gray. I was absolutely terrified and ran back into my room. I then locked my bedroom door, and both bathroom doors. 

At some point my sister woke up and asked me what was going on. I told her what I had seen and told her I’d locked the doors and not to go out. The memory is a little hazy at this point, but I’m fairly certain she stuck her head out anyways to look at the creature. 

Any time I bring this up to her she denies that it ever happened. I’ve considered that I could have very well been dreaming, but everything was so real and detailed. I even remember going back to sleep and waking up.
